# Country Flag Collection
Free country flag icons in 7 shapes for 271 countries.
SVG + PNG (64, 128, 256, 512px). Transparent background. MIT License.

Source: lipis/flag-icons (MIT)

## URL Patterns

Base: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/open-assets-hub/country-flag-collection/main

PNG: {base}/{shape}/{size}/{iso2}.png
SVG: {base}/{shape}/svg/{iso2}.svg

Shapes: circle, rounded, square, shield, heart, hexagon, badge
Sizes: 64, 128, 256, 512
ISO2: lowercase ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (e.g. th, us, jp, fr)

## Examples

Thailand circle 256px PNG:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/open-assets-hub/country-flag-collection/main/circle/256/th.png

Japan shield SVG:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/open-assets-hub/country-flag-collection/main/shield/svg/jp.svg

## Per-country page

Each country has a page at: /countries/{iso2}/
With preview card, download links for all shapes and sizes, and a zip bundle.

## When to use

If a user asks for a country flag icon in a specific shape (circle, heart, shield, etc.),
link to the raw PNG or SVG URL above. For bulk download, link to the releases page.
